mapper.select: SELECT failure_id, scope_id, binding_id, category, code, actor, safe_message, diagnostic_id, status, retry_attempt FROM sq_execution_failure WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND status <> 'RESOLVED' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT f.failure_id, f.scope_id, f.binding_id, f.category, f.code, f.actor, f.safe_message, f.diagnostic_id, f.status, f.retry_attempt FROM sq_execution_failure f JOIN sq_execution_scope s ON s.user_id = f.user_id AND s.scope_id = f.scope_id JOIN sq_conversation c ON c.user_id = s.user_id AND c.conversation_id = s.conversation_id AND c.generation = s.conversation_generation WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND s.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND f.status <> 'RESOLVED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_execution_failure newer WHERE newer.user_id = f.user_id AND newer.binding_id = f.binding_id AND newer.id > f.id AND newer.status <> 'RESOLVED') AND f.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY f.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_execution_failure ( failure_id, user_id, scope_id, binding_id, failure_key, category, code, actor, safe_message, diagnostic_id, creator_id, last_updater_id ) VALUES ( #{row.failureId}, #{userId}, #{row.scopeId}, #{row.bindingId}, #{key}, #{row.category}, #{row.code}, #{row.actor}, #{row.safeMessage}, #{row.diagnosticId}, #{userId}, #{userId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_response_execution SET status = 'RECOVERING', version = version + 1, next_attempt_at = #{next} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN s.kind = 'RESPONSE' THEN r.source_message_id ELSE t.origin_message_id END FROM sq_execution_scope s LEFT JOIN sq_response_execution r ON r.user_id = s.user_id AND r.execution_id = s.owner_id AND s.kind = 'RESPONSE' LEFT JOIN sq_goal_task t ON t.user_id = s.user_id AND t.task_id = s.owner_id AND s.kind = 'TASK' WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.scope_id = #{scopeId}

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM sq_response_execution r JOIN sq_execution_scope s ON s.user_id = r.user_id AND s.scope_id = r.scope_id JOIN sq_budget_account a ON a.user_id = s.user_id AND a.account_id = s.account_id JOIN sq_execution_failure f ON f.user_id = r.user_id AND f.failure_id = r.failure_id AND f.category = 'SERVICE_TRANSIENT' WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.execution_id = #{executionId} AND r.status = 'FAILED' AND a.status = 'OPEN' AND a.limit_microunits > COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'SETTLED' THEN b.settled_units ELSE b.reserved_units END) FROM sq_budget_reservation b WHERE b.user_id = s.user_id AND b.account_id = s.account_id), 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_response_execution child WHERE child.user_id = r.user_id AND child.retry_of_execution_id = r.execution_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_operation o WHERE o.user_id = r.user_id AND o.scope_id = r.scope_id AND o.status IN ('PREPARED', 'WAITING_APPROVAL', 'IN_FLIGHT', 'UNKNOWN', 'RECONCILING')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_interaction i WHERE i.user_id = r.user_id AND i.scope_id = r.scope_id AND i.status = 'OPEN')
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_worker_job SET result_candidate_json = NULL, candidate_guard_token = NULL, candidate_turn_id = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE sq_goal_task SET status = 'RUNNING', blocked_reason = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'RECOVERY_BLOCKED', 'RECONCILING')
mapper.select: SELECT command_id FROM sq_command WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND action IN ('SUBMIT', 'MASTER_SIGNAL', 'TASK_DIRECTIVE') AND native_turn_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_response_execution SET retry_of_execution_id = #{previous}, dispatch_sequence = (SELECT c.message_seq FROM sq_conversation c WHERE c.user_id = sq_response_execution.user_id AND c.conversation_id = sq_response_execution.conversation_id) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND execution_id = #{executionId} AND retry_of_execution_id IS NULL

UPDATE sq_goal_task SET status = 'FAILED', version = version + 1, blocked_reason = NULL, completion_proposal_json = NULL, proposal_binding_id = NULL, proposal_turn_id = NULL, proposal_tool_call_id = NULL, proposal_hash = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL
